... THIRD INNINGS ...

England have been bowled out for 253 by India! India have taken a massive first-innings lead of 143 runs and find themselves in the driver's seat. The visitors were handed yet another strong start from their openers. Zak Crawley was the aggressor of the two batters and got himself going quickly. While Ben Duckett and Ollie Pope struggled a bit, Crawley raced to a 52-ball fifty and looked set for a big score. However, he got out on 76 and it went downhill for England after that. Jasprit Bumrah and Kuldeep Yadav combined well on either side of the Tea break and gave India wickets at regular intervals. Jasprit Bumrah goes on to pick up another six-wicket haul and has been brilliant with the ball since Lunch. Along with him, Kuldeep Yadav picked up 3 important wickets for his side putting up an excellent bowling partnership with Jasprit since Lunch and both these bowlers kept the English batters at bay. India now walk to bat with a lead of 143 runs and have a huge upper hand in the game. England need to bowl them out as soon as possible to have some chance of a fight back. India dismissed England under two sessions and will walk out to bat again on Day 2 of this Test match.

Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the third and final session of Day 2! The two umpires walk their way out to the centre as do the Indian players. Out walk the two English batters, Jonny Bairstow and Ben Stokes. It will be Jasprit Bumrah to start the proceedings with the ball in the last session. Here we go...
... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ...

For England, it was all Zak Crawley in the first hour as he continued to find boundaries with regularity. After Duckett fell, Ollie Pope, at number 3, had a scratchy start to his innings. Crawley used his reach to good effect and brought up his fifty off just 52 balls. However, the birthday boy perished on 76 in trying to take down Axar Patel. From a position of strength at 114/1, England found themselves struggling at 136/4 in no time. Jonny Bairstow and Ben Stokes then got together and weathered the storm to ensure that England did not lose any more wickets. Although India got four wickets in that session, England scored at around 4 runs per over but they still trail by 241 runs. Will India continue to chip away with wickets? Or will it be the Bairstow-Stokes combination to 'Bazball' their way out of trouble? Join us back at 2.30 pm IST (9.00 am GMT) to see how the third session unfolds.

SESSION SUMMARY - 123 runs, 27 overs and 4 wickets. End of a pretty entertaining session! After England completely bossed the first hour thanks to Zak Crawley, Jasprit Bumrah's tide-turning spell helped India storm their way back into the game. At the start of the second session, Kuldeep Yadav and Ravichandran Ashwin bowled with great control with the former getting the first breakthrough. A magnificent catch from Shreyas Iyer gave the hosts the opening they desperately needed. Brought back into the attack for a burst, Jasprit Bumrah produced a seam bowling masterclass and won the battle against Joe Root before going to get rid of India's tormentor from the last game in Ollie Pope.

England at Lunch are 32/0 after batting 6 overs in the First session. It's Zak Crawley batting on 15 and Ben Duckett on 17 to start the Second session for England. Jasprit Bumrah to start the attack right after Lunch. Let's Play!
... DAY 2, SECOND SESSION ...

England have come out and have been attacking strong from the word GO! James Anderson bowled a brilliant first spell, picking up the important wicket of Ravichandran Ashwin under the circumstances, pushing India back again by dismissing Yashasvi Jaiswal soon after, which was the highlight of the morning. The English spinners Rehan Ahmed and the debutant Shoaib Bashir bowled brilliantly on a good wicket and grabbed 3 wickets each along with James Anderson. England now looks at a healthy target of 396 and anything over 300 runs under the circumstances looks like a good score to go into the second innings of India. England just need to bat and keep getting those runs till the time the wicket is still good for the batters. An exciting session of play coming up for you. Stay tuned.

SESSION SUMMARY- 25 OVERS, 92 RUNS AND 4 WICKETS! That is LUNCH on Day 2!  The session fully belongs to England as after getting 4 Indian wickets since morning, they have come out and batted strong and now are 32/0 in 6 overs with Zak Crawley batting on 13 and Ben Duckett on 17 off just 8 balls. England have batted positively as is their style these days and both the openers have come out hitting boundaries. India is still in search of the first blow as they leave the field for lunch.

Fires it in now does Ashwin, full and on off, Zak Crawley gets half-forward and drives it towards wide mid off where Kuldeep Yadav dives to his left and keeps it to just a single. That will be LUNCH on DAY 2!
